content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms frequently fail creators in regions like Kenya, either by outright rejecting transactions or imposing excessive fees. COREMERCH's sovereign infrastructure allows you to create a digital commerce stack that operates independently of these conventional systems. You have complete ownership and control over your setup without worrying about third-party access. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you can establish a reliable and flexible sales framework. This ensures that you can serve customers globally while bypassing the limitations imposed by conventional platforms, ultimately empowering your creative business with the autonomy it deserves.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To begin, gather your digital products ready for sale—these could be ebooks, courses, templates, or any digital asset. Next, you will need essential tools: a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Ensure you have a clear vision of your target audience and product offerings, as this will guide your marketing efforts and help you optimize your sales strategy. By having these components ready, you position yourself for a seamless deployment of your sovereign stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, ensuring you're ready for global transactions. Integrate this with your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This integration is crucial for verifying payments and triggering product deliveries. Next, create a delivery mechanism using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to host and deliver your digital products automatically upon payment confirmation. With the right webhook setups, you can ensure that your customers receive their purchases instantly, creating a professional shopping experience that builds trust. This robust payment and delivery pipeline keeps your operations running smoothly and efficiently.
Establish complete control over your digital commerce.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your infrastructure, it's time to go live. Launch your online store and promote it via social media or your network to attract initial traffic. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration will handle the cryptocurrency transaction automatically. Ensure you monitor your dashboard for transaction confirmation and troubleshoot any immediate issues that arise. Processing your first transaction is a critical step; it validates the reliability of your setup and provides real-world feedback. Use this experience to fine-tune your processes and prepare for ongoing sales. Establishing a smooth initial transaction reinforces your commitment to customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital commerce stack is live and functioning effectively, consider scaling your operations. Evaluate your product offerings and explore additional digital products that complement your current catalog. Utilize feedback from early customers to refine your offerings and marketing strategies. Consider automation tools to manage customer interactions and streamline your sales processes further. As your sales volume increases, assess the performance of your backend infrastructure and make necessary adjustments to maintain efficiency. COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit provides additional resources for scaling, enabling you to explore new opportunities without compromising on service quality. This growth will help you reach a broader audience and amplify your revenue potential.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To start selling digital products with crypto without Stripe, you need to set up your own sovereign commerce infrastructure. Utilize tools such as Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, Google Drive for file delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Deploy your stack efficiently and ensure automated payment processing and product delivery. This allows you to maintain sovereignty over your digital products and operations while generating revenue seamlessly.
Sell directly to customers without intermediaries.

The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is your all-in-one solution for creating a robust digital commerce infrastructure. It includes essential blueprints and templates to help you deploy your stack quickly and efficiently. With this kit, you can easily integrate payment processing and automate product delivery, setting you up for long-term success in selling digital products.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Prepare your digital products for sale, ensuring they are ready for distribution. 2. Create accounts with GitHub or Cloudflare and NOWPayments for hosting and payment processing. 3. Set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. 4. Choose between Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and management. 5. Configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for automated product delivery. 6. Test your entire infrastructure to ensure seamless transactions and delivery before launching. 7. Promote your store through social media and networks to attract customers. 8. Monitor your operations and adjust as necessary based on customer feedback.
Frequently Asked Questions
What digital products can I sell?

You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, design templates, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The flexibility of the infrastructure allows you to offer any digital asset you create.
How do I set up my payment processing?
Set up an account with NOWPayments, which allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. Integrate this with your backend logic to automate payment verification and product delivery.
What are the hosting options available?
You can use free hosting options like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. These platforms provide reliable infrastructure without the need for subscriptions or complex setups.
Can I scale my operations easily?
Yes, once your infrastructure is running, you can easily add more products and automate processes. The Complete Builder Kit offers additional resources for efficient scaling.
What support is available after deployment?
With the Complete Builder Kit, you receive documentation and resources to assist you after deployment. You can refer to these materials as you expand your operations.
